comments.value: I'd love to have this option! I am very anti-ai and even if you're not, we should at least have the right to choose what we're exposed to! Please consider this type of toggle! thank you
Yes please. I desperately want to filter out the garbage.

Some people here might also be interested in:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/tackle-the-misleading-world-thumbnails-issue

i hate this AI topic, but this is more of like clickbate previews made or enhanced with AI.

also i don't mind if one single object was made by AI, the final composition should be true to the user uploading and tagged correctly

Only reason i am against this is because the level of witch hunting that will occur will be off the scale. You will have every virtue signaller see a texture offset but a pixel and start screaming "ai" like a body snatcher warning the horde that it saw a misaligned pixel, whixh then proceeds to turn into a hate mob to ruin someones life over something that was not ai.

I see others stating that world creators are going to be potentially witch hunted over someone crying wolf in regards to something that looks like AI to them in the worlds, but having grown incredibly tired of seeing so many different worlds with AI generated preview images that are just undeniably identifiable as AI, I think doing something like this would be possible with the more evident instances of AI content being noticed on VRChat's platform. I definitely feel strongly for ensuring something like this isn't abused but I would love to see some sort of way of labeling these worlds with a tag that I can use to then filter out from searches.

I think that creators may still lie about the usage of genAI, combating it on the platform should go hand in hand with a like+dislike system for worlds. Worlds with misleading AI thumbnails, or noticeable AI usage (or even just bad quality/broken worlds) will get more dislikes.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/the-ability-to-like-and-dislike-or-vote-on-worlds

@{6295a3a0cab11f0b763e6750|full_name} what's stopping someone from pixel peeping and starting a witch hunt right now though? i'm not saying they should, that absolutely shouldn't happen, but adding a tag for genai content would make no difference in that regard. if anything witch hunts would be less likely since there'd be less people aggravated about ai in the first place.

I think this is a great idea. It could be like a peanut allergy warning. 

Warning: this product (avatar/world) contains peanuts (genAI) and anyone allergic to peanuts (anyone that doesn't like AI) should avoid. 

Caution: this product (avatar/world) may contain peanuts (genAI) people allergic to peanuts (people that don't like AI) should be prepared to encounter peanuts (genAI content)

Peanut(AI)-free: this product (avatar/world) is guaranteed to be peanut (genAI) free. people allergic to peanuts (people that don't like AI) can enjoy without worry.
fuck ai and stop data centers

details:
With the wave of generative AI content used throughout games/platforms that run on user-generated content such as VRChat, it should be required that creators tag their avatars & worlds appropriately with "Contains Generative AI Content" when the avatar/world contains ANY generative AI assets/content.

The goal is so that users who do not wish to see such content, can filter it out through VRChat's native Content Gating system.

Screenshot below as an example.
title: Add "Contains Generative AI Content" tag to the Content Gating system
